persona: Expert (D3, bike-repair queue). Short, complete answers full of workshop jargon. The brief covers every field except the glossary, although it uses 'true', 'bleed', 'ticket' and 'bench time'. Expected: ready in 1 to 2 rounds plus the playback, the jargon in the glossary, few repeated questions. Runs end to end (charter-writer, critic, verifier, gate).

glossary: Truing: straightening a wheel so it spins without a wobble ('true a wheel'). Bleeding: pushing air out of a hydraulic brake line ('bleed a hydraulic brake'). Ticket: one repair job on the board. Bench time: the minutes a mechanic spends on a job.
open_questions: Only the e-bike one: do motor jobs belong in this queue? The workshop lead decides.

why: Expert persona: the round-budget floor (should not use the budget). Field recall over all 22 fields; the glossary is the one gap. End to end: the final charter is compared with reference_charter (field values and citations) and checked for invented content.
